stages.title: Before removal
stages.explanation: The member can retrieve the known state and image.

stages.title: Remove membership
stages.explanation: An owner removes membership; the existing session is retained.

stages.title: Check the same session
stages.explanation: Authentication still succeeds. Identity alone does not grant permission.

stages.title: Recheck access and owner control
stages.explanation: The former member's state request is denied. The image is not visible; the owner can still retrieve both.

stages.title: Restore membership
stages.explanation: The lab restores membership before its final positive checks.

stages.title: Verify restored access
stages.explanation: The member sees the state and the same known image again.

authorization.limits: Historical local checks of /api/state and /api/chat-image on a copied development app with synthetic identities. Separate from the Wazuh ledger replay; these are not the same events. A 404 alone does not prove authorization denial.

engineering.title: Interrupted delivery
engineering.problem: A write stops after only part of an event batch reaches the file.
engineering.control: Verify the retained prefix and append only the missing suffix; acknowledge only after the write is flushed.
engineering.adverse_test: Seed a half-written batch, retry twice, and verify one exact complete copy plus an unchanged second retry.
engineering.limit: Local file recovery; this does not prove Wazuh receipt or exactly-once delivery across replay runs.

engineering.title: Lost acknowledgement
engineering.problem: File bytes are complete, but the database still says the batch is pending.
engineering.control: Recognize the exact existing bytes, flush them again and advance the database checkpoint without appending a duplicate.
engineering.adverse_test: Place the complete batch before its checkpoint and verify the retry performs a flush without changing file bytes.
engineering.limit: An injected acknowledgement gap, not a physical power-loss or PostgreSQL crash experiment.

engineering.title: Damaged evidence
engineering.problem: An imported receipt is changed to claim extra records, a different application or a continuous connection.
engineering.control: Revalidate the latest receipt before presentation and show that it needs review instead of retaining a verified state.
engineering.adverse_test: Alter receipt fields, including with a recalculated digest, and require the console to suppress its verified result.
engineering.limit: Consistency checking under a trusted local administrator; hashes are not independent attestation.

engineering.title: Failed scan presented as clean
engineering.problem: A target outage is relabelled as a successful scan or given successful finding counts.
engineering.control: Require the outage mode to remain failed with incomplete coverage and reject contradictory reports.
engineering.adverse_test: Change failure status, finding counts or scanner exit code separately; each contradictory bundle must be rejected.
engineering.limit: Offline validation tests supplement the separate historical ZAP outage and retry shown above.
